[[File:TempleofYavin4-AoRCR.png|thumb|The [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was a ziggurat]]
A '''ziggurat''' was a type of pyramidal structure. These structures were built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gobindi]] by the [[Gobindi (species)|native people]]. They were made of slabs of stone stacked on top of each other, each slab a little bit smaller than the one below it, so that the sides of the structures looked like giant staircases. The natives built them to contain a [[Gobindi virus|deadly virus]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], all civilization on Gobindi was based in buildings built atop the ziggurats.

Another example of a ziggurat was the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], as shown in a drawing by [[Je'daii Order]] [[Master]] [[Jake Fenn]].<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref>

The [[Temple of Pomojema]] was also considered a ziggurat.<ref name="Splinter">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>
